sources.title: Owner's public GitHub mirrors of the group's 30 competition rasters
sources.used_for: the live-anchored calibration of knowledge/10: 25 rasters whose SHA-256 matches a row of the owner's own hash<->score ledger, spanning reported DTI 0.0020-0.2477 and emitted mass 44k-514k px
sources.how_verified: each path was read from a GitHub REST tree listing (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1) and each file was fetched through api.github.com by scripts/restore_artifacts.py, then SHA-256 hashed locally and matched against evidence/provenance/gemsdoe27_live_scores_snapshot.json
sources.caveats: A hash match proves the mirror is unchanged and ties a file to a row of the owner's ledger. It does NOT prove the organizer scored those bytes, and the DTI values remain user/owner-reported claims. Four rows have no ledger match and are excluded (IR-25-ARTEFACT-SCORE-LINK). raw.githubusercontent.com is unreachable from this sandbox; only api.github.com was used. drivendata.org was never contacted.

sources.title: Official reference solution — U-Net with Monte-Carlo cross-validation (Prof. John Lipor, Portland State University)
sources.publisher: DrivenData (organizer) on GitHub; notebook author John Lipor
sources.used_for: corroboration of the metric weights and the data contract, read this session: TverskyLoss(alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, mode='binary') matches the published DTI weights; nodata handled as X[X < -1e38] = NaN (the mirror's sentinel is -3.4028234663852886e+38); labels read as y[y < 1] = 0; per-channel min-max normalisation; the reference reads each band's own TIFF tags (description, data_category) for band semantics; patches are kept where 'y > 0' and channel index 4 is finite; the submission is written as a single-band float32 GeoTIFF with the labels' CRS/transform and NO nodata tag, i.e. finite everywhere; and the author notes 'it may be advantageous to threshold this map for better scoring'
sources.how_verified: README.md and all 21 notebook cells (unet-mc-cv-reference-solution.ipynb, 1,578,736 B) read through api.github.com from this sandbox; the channel-4 claim was then tested against the restored mirror's own per-band non-finite masks
sources.caveats: This is github.com/drivendataorg, NOT drivendata.org, so reading it does not touch the host whose Terms of Use bar automatic access (AGENTS.md rule 3); no competition page, leaderboard or data-download page was requested. The repo carries no licence file, so quote it, do not vendor it. The notebook's data file is named data/numeric_features.tif; the owner mirror of the same 19-band raster is gems-geodawn-numerical-features.tif (418,912,844 B). The reference solution's own score is not published anywhere in the repo.
